mof_ops.detail: No switch, buyback or T-bill auction in the windows (15-29 Apr). April plan (31 Mar): no switch auctions; the only T-bill auction (50-week, 10 Apr, settlement 14 Apr) is pre-window. MoF DB shows no other wholesale operations 30 Mar - 5 May besides the 15/23/28 Apr sales.

April regular sale supply incl. additional sales (MoF DB, derived): 15 Apr 11,063.85m + 23 Apr 10,166.93m + 28 Apr 9,115.875m = 30,346.655m. Financing of 2026 gross needs: 41% end-March (PKO via PAP 13 Apr, pre-window) -> ~48% after 23 Apr (Erste estimate, 24 Apr) -> ~49% after 28 Apr (MoF to PAP, 28 Apr 17:08). PAP 19 Apr: MoF returned to regular sales after the March turmoil; 23 Apr is the second of three April sales. May supply plan: NOT published by 29 Apr (gov.pl communique dated 30 Apr; PAP Skrot 30 Apr 17:02) - content not used.

No foreign bond issue, mandate or prefinancing announcement in the windows (the USD issue communique of 7 Apr is pre-window; next FX item on the MoF list is the 15 May April account).

digest.2026-04-16: 15 Apr: MoF sold PLN 10.7bn (offer 6-12bn, demand 12.1bn) plus 0.35bn additional; PS0731 5.3bn at 5.02%, DS1035 2.5bn at 5.51%, WS0428 1.3bn at 4.27%. Final March CPI confirmed at 3.0% y/y (m/m 1.1%): fuels +15% m/m, services 5.0%, food 2.1%. The budget deficit after March was 69.6bn, 25.6% of the 271.7bn limit. FX on budget accounts EUR 13.5bn. IMF Fiscal Monitor: 2026 GG deficit 6.7% of GDP. The Fiscal Council said the SRW defence-clause bill weakens the fiscal rules. EUR/PLN 4.23, back near its pre-war level. 10Y ~5.5%.
digest.2026-04-17: 16 Apr: NBP core inflation rose to 2.7% y/y in March (0.5% m/m, consensus 2.6%). HICP 3.2%. GUS revised Q4 GDP to 4.1% y/y. BGK sold FPC bonds for 1.06bn against 1.89bn demand, plus 0.21bn additional. PKO called the 15 Apr MoF sale positive. MPC hold talk lifted the short end while 5-10Y rallied (PKO: room to flatten; on a peace deal 2Y <4.2%, 10Y 5.3-5.4%). Banks (PKO, Erste, Millennium) expect CPI ~3-3.5% in Q2 and rates on hold to year-end.
digest.2026-04-20: 17-19 Apr: MPC's Wnorowski (PAP interview, first cited 17 Apr am): rates can stay stable for longer, with the direction to be clarified after the July projection. If inflation does not stay moderate, the MPC should signal the risk of higher rates given loose fiscal policy. He sees no case for cuts. Energy minister Motyka: no phase-out of the CPN fuel package in the coming weeks. Fiscal Council's Toroj: the package's flexibility hurts fiscal transparency. Fri 17 Apr: Hormuz reopening lifted SPW, yields -15bp, 10Y 5.38%. PAP consensus for March: wages 6.3%, industry 4.2%, retail 5.9%.
digest.2026-04-21: 20 Apr: Domanski (TOK FM): withdrawing the reduced VAT and excise on fuels in early May would be premature. No PIT-threshold change in 2026. MoF: State Treasury debt was 2,050.6bn at end-March, +13.1bn m/m, FX share 20.1%. Millennium: the market prices about one NBP hike by year-end; its own base case is stable rates. ING: most MPC members lean to stable rates. BGK: 10Y to stay below 5.43%. BPS: reference rate 3.75%; next MPC 5-6 May. The weekend re-closure of Hormuz trimmed Friday's rally; 10Y 5.40%.
digest.2026-04-22: 21 Apr: strong March data. Industry +9.4% y/y (consensus 4.2%); wages +6.6% (6.3%); employment -0.9% (-0.8%); construction +0.4% (-1.3%); PPI -0.8% (-0.1%). MoF will offer 7-12bn on 23 Apr, including the new 10Y DS0436. SPW yields rose 5-9bp; 10Y 5.48%. MoF rebutted the Fiscal Council on the SRW clause. Erste: Domanski sees no need to amend the 2026 budget. DB: reference rate 3.75% through December, CPI rising to 4.3%. BGK plans a 1.5bn dividend to the budget. Kurtek: rates stable for at least several months.
digest.2026-04-23: 22 Apr: GUS put the 2025 GG deficit at 7.3% of GDP (prelim 7.2%) and debt at 59.7%. Fiscal notification: 2026 deficit ~6.8% (budget act 6.5%), debt 65.1%. Domanski: gradual deficit cuts, but not at the expense of defence; windfall-tax assumptions by end-April. PKO: Domanski sees a high chance the fuel package is extended into May. GUS April business climate stable or better (transport worse); firms expect faster cost growth. SPW yields +4-7bp. PKO's Adamiak no longer sees cuts this year.
digest.2026-04-24: 23 Apr: MoF sold 8.98bn (offer 7-12bn, demand 11.19bn) plus 1.19bn additional. Debut of DS0436 (1.36bn at 5.68%); PS0731 4.62bn at 5.15%. March retail sales +8.7% y/y real (consensus 5.9%); M3 +11.5%. Consumer confidence fell to -14.1, while the GUS consumer price-expectations index eased to 29.4. MPC's Zarzecki (Bloomberg): rates unchanged for long, any move likely up. Tyrowicz: wages still an inflation risk. 10Y 5.58%. The EC sent Poland the SAFE loan agreement; KPO 30bn on 1 June.
digest.2026-04-27: 24-26 Apr: GPW lists the new DS0436 (25 Apr 2036, PL0000119087) from 28 Apr. Tusk wants the SAFE loan kept out of the deficit; SAFE advance ~PLN 20bn after signing. March unemployment 6.1%; new orders -7.3% y/y; GUS composite 99.0. Erste: rates flat to year-end, 2026 needs ~48% covered after 23 Apr. Long end ~5.64%, +20bp on the week as oil rose. The MoF's 28 Apr offer was due Friday 15:00 but its content is not confirmed until 27 Apr. Coal-mining support ~2bn in 2026.
digest.2026-04-28: 27 Apr: the March voting record shows Wnorowski and Tyrowicz opposed the 25bp cut (8:2); Tyrowicz's 75bp hike motion was rejected for the third month. Reduced VAT and excise on fuels were extended from 30 Apr to 15 May (Dz.U.). Balczun: the CPN package stays while needed. MoF offers 5-10bn on 28 Apr (OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1034, DS0436, NZ0936). BGK FPC tender on 29 Apr (min 0.5bn). FWSZ 2026 bond plan +2.9bn to 76.6bn. GS: April CPI 2.8%, high bar for hikes. 10Y ~5.68%.
digest.2026-04-29: 28 Apr: MoF sold 9.0bn (offer 5-10bn, demand 11.1bn) plus 0.11bn additional; DS0436 1.31bn at 5.83%, PS0731 4.79bn at 5.32%. 2026 financing ~49%. The government's macro assumptions put the 2026 GG deficit at 6.8% of GDP and debt at 65.1%, with GDP 3.6% and CPI 2.5% (pre-war basis; war-shock CPI 3.2%). A windfall tax is to offset the fuel package. GPWB 30 Apr change: PS0731 joins TBSP (18 bonds), WS0429 moves to 1-3Y, WZ1126 leaves BWZ. Erste: the market prices two 25bp NBP hikes in 2026. 10Y 5.72%.
digest.2026-04-30: 29 Apr: BGK sold FPC bonds for 0.69bn against 0.94bn demand. EC April ESI 100.2 (101.0); consumer inflation expectations 39.3. Domanski: windfall-tax revenue >4bn; higher alcohol excise and a sugar fee planned. The 1-15 May fuel VAT and excise cuts cost ~0.85bn. Citi: CPI to ~4% by end-2026. PKO: 2026 GDP 3.5%, risks to the downside. Erste: rates rising on IRS/FRA. SPW sold off further ahead of Fed/ECB: DS1035 5.76%, PS0731 5.36%; EUR/PLN 4.257. April flash CPI due 30 Apr, consensus ~3.0%.
